title: core ipld root_node: operator_signature has no post-construction setter
description: core/ipld/root_node.rs: ArticleMetadata.operator_signature is set to Vec::new() in compute_metadata; comment says 'Empty until signing wired in'. No method exists to set the signature after construction, so callers must manually reconstruct ArticleRootNode. Easy to forget and ship unsigned articles. Add set_operator_signature() or a builder pattern.
